mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4% in the month preceding the decision date is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% in the month before decision
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in >50% of FEDFUNDS > 4% months, or IC > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 5% for two consecutive months, wage growth accelerates and consumer confidence rises, both of which predict a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of such labor market events, or IC < -0.1 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in home sales (HOUST) coinciding with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a shift from manufacturing to consumption demand, forecasting a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: HOUST month-on-month increase > 10% while INDPRO month-on-month decrease > 5%
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >30% of such structural shifts, or IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 90 for three consecutive months suggests supply-side weakness that persists into future quarters, yielding a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above 90 for 6 months, or 20-day returns are positive in >70% of such contractions.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 2% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to underperform over the next 20 days as investors anticipate rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are non-negative in >50% of such inflation episodes, or IC > 0.1 over 1-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 6% triggers a wage–price spiral that elevates consumer spending, producing a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >40% of such episodes, or IC < 0.05 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising retail employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 while manufacturing employment stagnates (INDPRO flat), signal a shift toward services demand, predicting a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative in >30% of such events, or IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the RSAFS series for three consecutive months indicates weakening commercial and industrial credit availability, which is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: RSAFS recovers to trend in 3 months, or 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such contractions.
